messages.content: The bicycle chain is clean and the rear brake needs adjustment.

Record the brake adjustment before the next ride.

For the unrelated Cedar courtyard plan, a sensor with a timer fallback could retain predictable behavior when readings fail. This is an option to examine, not an accepted decision.
The brake adjustment is on my list. Rain also showed why Cedar timer-only watering can waste water. Investigate the sensor-plus-fallback proposal; do not adopt it yet.
The open Cedar question is what happens when a reading is absent. Sensor-only control is still outside the accepted plan.
